priceUsd is the same close converted by FactSet; priceUsd / price gives the FX rate used for USD market caps.
iad = FactSet indicated annual dividend (iadDefTradingAdj) with its effective date.

history[]: one row per month-end, 2021-09 to 2026-09 (61). price = FactSet close in local currency on the month's last trading day (priceDate; a closed market day takes the last close before it: 2024-03-28/29 Holy Week, AIA 2024-06-28). ntmEbitda / ntmEps = consensus_rolling NTMA mean sampled monthly (estimateDate; currency ESTIMATE = local). netDebt / minority = FF_NET_DEBT and FF_MIN_INT_ACCUM of the latest balance sheet already reported at the month-end (epsReportDate on or before it; QTR for the quarterly reporters, SEMI for FHZN and AIA); bsPeriod names it. sharesM = FactSet shares_outstanding at the month-end for the peers (one class each, as in the current market value); GAP = total B + BB from the model's share history (505,277,464 through 2026-05-06, 595,018,195 from 2026-05-07; FactSet lists the series B only).
